name: J.B. Hunt

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (J. B. Hunt logo.svg)

description: J.B. Hunt is a North American surface-transportation company with five segments. The largest, Intermodal (JBI), pairs its own 53-foot containers and chassis with Class I railroads (mostly BNSF and Norfolk Southern) and truck drayage. Dedicated Contract Services (DCS) supplies trucks and drivers under three-to-ten-year contracts so shippers can outsource a private fleet, and earns the best margin. The rest is freight brokerage (ICS), last-mile delivery of big-and-bulky goods (FMS), and conventional dry-van truckload (JBT). 2025 revenue was $12.0B and operating income $865M (7.2%), with the top ten customers 33% of revenue.

gics.note: Conventional GICS sector and sub-industry as listed in Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies), read 2026-10-01; industry group and industry are not shown there. SEC SIC 4213 (Trucking, No Local).

hq.note: 615 J.B. Hunt Corporate Drive, Lowell, AR (10-K cover); incorporated in Arkansas

employees.note: 21,554 company drivers, 8,481 office personnel, 1,374 maintenance technicians, 341 delivery and material assistants; plus 2,350 independent contractors; non-union

businessLines.name: Intermodal (JBI)
businessLines.how: Revenue per container load moved by rail plus drayage, priced by contractual and spot quotes with little long-term commitment; profit depends on network balance and rail service.

businessLines.name: Dedicated Contract Services (DCS)
businessLines.how: Long-term (3 to 10 years, average about 5) contracts for dedicated trucks, drivers and equipment; cost-plus style pricing recovers fixed costs regardless of utilization.

businessLines.name: Integrated Capacity Solutions (ICS)
businessLines.how: Freight brokerage margin: charges the shipper and pays a third-party carrier (about 126,000 available carriers), plus an online multimodal marketplace.

businessLines.name: Final Mile Services (FMS)
businessLines.how: Delivery, installation and set-up of big-and-bulky products to consumers through cross-dock networks, paid per delivery under retailer contracts.

businessLines.name: Truckload (JBT)
businessLines.how: Full-load dry-van freight per load on contract and spot rates, plus drop-trailer 360box program.
